title: Appending choices after halting
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register machine, let $	ext{oracle}$ be an oracle, let $x$ be an input bit string, and let $a$ be an initial configuration. If the run on a finite choice string $\sigma$ has halted, then for every finite choice string $\tau$, running on the concatenation $\sigma\tau$ yields exactly the same configuration as running on $\sigma$.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle and input bit string
An initial configuration whose run on $\sigma$ is halted
